seconds_target: 約4分（カスタムのスライダー240秒）
budget: Suno 360クレジット以内・購入なし（本人おまかせ 11/9）
order: A→F を回す（金属の打鍵 B・E は3曲離れる）
trial: まず各種1回（12曲・60）で声・楽器・尺・既存曲に聞こえないかを確かめてから残り24回

leads.name: ジャズピアノトリオ（アコースティックピアノ）
leads.style: A warm acoustic grand piano in the foreground, a gentle jazz piano trio, a simple singing original melody in the right hand with soft wintry chord voicings, tender and close, never flashy runs. F major, 76 BPM. Instrumental cozy Christmas jazz for a quiet living room on a snowy winter night by a softly lit Christmas tree. Soft brushed drums with a relaxed swing, a warm walking upright bass, soft sleigh bells gently shimmering in the background throughout, warm wintry jazz chords, gentle tape warmth. An entirely ORIGINAL melody: never quote or imitate any traditional Christmas carol or famous Christmas song. A festive, wintry holiday mood, cozy, warm and unhurried, never sleepy, never dramatic. A long, continuous piece that keeps the same easy groove all the way through, with no breakdowns and no dramatic build. About four minutes, gentle natural ending. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no whistling. No fireplace, no wind, no field recordings.
